_comment: The registration this harness's hooks need, and the source of truth for it.
install.sh merges this into .claude/settings.json, which is a build output and
is gitignored: committing both would leave two files claiming to be the
registration with no way to tell which one the host actually read.
$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR resolves to the repo root, so the installed copy under
.claude/hooks/ is what runs -- not the source tree beside it. That is the same
copy-not-symlink call decisions/install.md made for commands and skills: a
passing run has to prove the installed copy works.
